step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows an architecture for Ticketmaster's checkout system. At the top, users interact through a CDN layer (CloudFront). The CDN routes web page rendering requests to EKS running Next.js, and API requests to AWS AppSync. AppSync handles queries and mutations, routing single-step operations to AWS Lambda (which reads/writes to Amazon DynamoDB) and complex multi-step workflows to AWS Step Functions ('Step Functions Purchase'). DynamoDB uses Global Tables with cross-region replication indicated by a double-headed arrow spanning regions.
